name: The Rescue
summary: In Tarren Mill, Krusk seeks help after Syndicate bandits capture the orc scouts sent into Durnholde Keep. Thrall had sent the party to investigate the growing threat and retrieve an object from the keep.

sections.title: A Scout Mission Gone Wrong
sections.body: Warchief Thrall sent a band of orc warriors to the Hillsbrad Foothills to investigate the growing Syndicate threat and retrieve an object from Durnholde Keep. Gol'dir led the scouts toward the fortress ruins, where the Syndicate's numbers overwhelmed them in an ambush. Krusk broke free and limped back across the river to Tarren Mill. Drull, Tog'thar, and Gol'dir were captured by the human bandits.

sections.title: Chains in the Ruins
sections.body: Durnholde carries bitter memories for the orcs. It once housed Aedelas Blackmoore's internment camps, where captive orcs were kept lethargic and forced into gladiatorial slavery. Now Drull and Tog'thar are bound in iron within the keep's cracked stone walls, another insult to the Horde. Free the two scouts from the Syndicate jailors who hold the keys to their shackles, then learn what became of their commander, Gol'dir.

faq.q: Why were orcs sent into Durnholde Keep in the first place?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall sent Gol'dir and his scout cadre to investigate Syndicate bandits and retrieve an object from Durnholde Keep.

faq.q: Who are the captives being rescued?
faq.answer: Drull and Tog'thar are orc scouts sent by the Horde under Gol'dir's command. Syndicate brigands overwhelmed them and bound them in ball and chain inside the ruins.

faq.q: Where is the squad's leader, Gol'dir?
faq.answer: After Drull and Tog'thar are freed, Krusk discovers that the Syndicate separated Gol'dir from the main party and moved him to an unknown second location.

faq.q: Who is holding the scouts captive?
faq.answer: The Syndicate holds the scouts. This aristocratic criminal network operates from the ruins of Lordaeron and Alterac, and its jailors guard the captives inside Durnholde.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
faq.answer: Freeing the scouts leads to a search for Gol'dir, with a mission to track down and infiltrate the Syndicate. The trail eventually reaches deeper into the Syndicate's affairs.

faq.q: Why does Durnholde Keep hold special meaning to the Horde?
faq.answer: Durnholde was where Aedelas Blackmoore raised Thrall as a gladiator and commanded the Alliance internment camps after the Second War. Thrall later led a rebellion and laid waste to the keep.

angles.text: As an orc, seeing your warriors shackled in Durnholde cuts straight to the painful history of internment. Freeing them is personal.
As a member of the Horde, you take part in an early effort to counter the Syndicate's expansion across the contested hills of Lordaeron.
As a warrior, you stand with fellow fighters by breaking them out of captivity from dishonorable human bandits.
